text: {"class": "fixable", "chokepoint": [], "floor_ms": 0, "L_delta": 0, "rationale": "The gap is start-up overhead. Excluding start-up, both do about 0.3 ms of data work (uutils 2.4-2.1, GNU 1.2-0.9). uutils' extra ~1.2 ms comes from dynamically loading and relocating a 19 MB multicall binary. The contract freezes no component, and static non-PIE linking, LTO, stripping and fewer relocations keep it pure Rust and one binary. These build-setting changes target that start-up cost, so no frozen floor exists."}
